en.headline: Jockey Club Kai Tak Water Sports Centre holds grand opening ceremony
en.dek: The revitalised former fire station facility in Kai Tak hosted athletes and officials on Wednesday, with a parade showcasing dragon boating, rowing and kayaking.
body: The Jockey Club Kai Tak Water Sports Centre held its grand opening ceremony on Wednesday. The centre, which opened in July after revitalising the former Kai Tak Fire Station, is managed by the Hong Kong Water Sports Council with funding support from the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust.

Guests included Legislative Council member and Jockey Club director Kenneth Fok, Hong Kong Water Sports Council chairman Tang Lai, and representatives from the Fire Services Department, the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. Asian Games medal-winning rowers and sailors, including Zhao Xianzhen, Hong Wing-yan and Mak Hiu-tung, also attended and shared their experiences.

A parade featured students, elderly participants and people with disabilities demonstrating dragon boating, rowing and kayaking to highlight the centre's aim of inclusive access to water sports near the city centre. Organisers said the location's convenient transport and calmer waters make it suitable for beginners and a range of age groups.
The centre offers activities including dragon boating, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, rowing and other water and land experiences. It is located on Shing Fung Road in Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 賽馬會啟德水上運動中心舉行開幕典禮
zh.dek: 由舊啟德消防局活化而成的中心周三舉行開幕典禮，亞運獎牌得主出席，並有共融巡遊展示龍舟及賽艇。
body: 賽馬會啟德水上運動中心周三舉行開幕典禮。中心今年七月正式啟用，由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金撥款支持、將舊啟德消防局活化改建，現由香港水上運動議會管理。
出席嘉賓包括立法會議員兼賽馬會董事霍啟剛、香港水上運動議會主席鄧勵，以及消防處、文化體育及旅遊局和康樂及文化事務署代表。名古屋亞運男子輕量級單人雙漿金牌得主趙顯臻、女子輕量級單人雙漿銀牌洪詠甄及女子雙人49er FX級銀牌麥曉彤亦到場分享經驗。
活動設有「啟航巡遊」，由學生、長者及殘疾人士親自展示龍舟、賽艇及獨木舟，展現中心提倡共融及平等參與水上運動的理念。運動員指場地鄰近市區、交通方便，水面較平靜，適合新手及不同年齡人士。
中心提供龍舟、獨木舟、立划板、平板賽艇等多項水上活動及陸上體驗，地址位於啟德承豐道。
